title: UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2608.15516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.   Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures. translated_title: UniFed-VLM：面向视觉-语言模型的联邦指令调优，应对多重异构性
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在多模态理解和生成方面展现了强大的性能。然而，VLMs的微调通常依赖于集中式数据，这在某些领域（如医疗保健）中引发了隐私担忧。联邦学习（FL）通过允许在不共享原始数据的情况下进行模型训练，提供了一种自然的解决方案。然而，将FL应用于VLM指令调优极具挑战性。VLMs具有庞大的参数规模，并且在现实场景中，客户端在任务、模态和模型架构方面表现出显著的异构性。现有方法主要关注简化设置，无法处理这种多维异构场景。在本工作中，我们研究了任务、模态和模型架构联合异构下的联邦指令调优。我们提出了UniFed-VLM，一个统一的联邦指令调优框架，用于应对多种类型的异构性。
tldr: 本文提出UniFed-VLM，一个统一框架，首次同时解决联邦指令调优中任务、模态和模型架构的多重异构性挑战，以在隐私保护下实现VLMs高效协作调优。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes UniFed-VLM, a unified framework that addresses the joint heterogeneity of tasks, modalities, and model architectures in federated instruction tuning, enabling privacy-preserving collaborative fine-tuning of VLMs.
